localBefore.cause: No BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN / empty local durable store; not the production failure mode

primaryRootCause.defect: scanRange passed topics:[SWAP_TOPIC,MINT_TOPIC,BURN_TOPIC] which means topic0=SWAP AND topic1=MINT AND topic2=BURN. Uniswap-V2 Swap/Mint/Burn never match.

measuredProof.conclusion: flat [SWAP,MINT,BURN] is AND across topic slots and returns 0; nested [[SWAP,MINT,BURN]] is OR on topic0 and finds events

primaryRootCause.consequence: Gap-fill advanced coverageRanges to ~100% while finding nearly zero events; health reported ready with Swap:3 (anchor + rare head/per-topic finds).

secondaryDefect.defect: Burn(address,uint256,uint256) hashed to non-Uniswap topic; correct is Burn(address,uint256,uint256,address).
secondaryDefect.impact: Burn events missed even under correct OR filter; Swap/Mint unaffected.

ruledOut.evidence: pairSyncEngine uses pair.pairAddress; Factory registry separate

repair: self-heal clears false-complete coverage when Swap<=3 and coverage>=90%
